mapper.select: select t.id, t.group_id, t.module_code, t.title, t.creator_id, t.create_time, t.update_time, u.nick_name as creator_name, g.group_name as group_name, (select count(*) from te_topic_reply r where r.topic_id = t.id) as reply_count from te_topic t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.creator_id left join te_group g on g.id = t.group_id where t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into te_topic (group_id, module_code, title, creator_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{groupId}, #{moduleCode}, #{title}, #{creatorId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update te_topic set update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
